data.title: Windows foreground type_text corrupts multiline text in Notepad 0.22.2
data.body:
## Environment

- Driver: `@trycua/cua-driver 0.22.2`.
- Target: foreground modern Notepad; its package version was not recorded.
- Windows build, driver binary hash, architecture, keyboard layout, and IME state were not recorded.
- Each attempt used synthetic text in a fresh blank Notepad tab. The document value was observed through a fresh UIA snapshot before and after a `CuaDriver.callTool` call made through `openCuaBootstrapSession`; no model or Harness loop was involved.

## Reproduction

Open a new blank Notepad tab and confirm its document value is empty. Call `type_text` for that window with `delivery_mode: "foreground"` and no `element_token`, then read the document value from a fresh `get_window_state` call. Compare content after normalizing line endings only (`CRLF` or `CR` to `LF`); do not trim or collapse blank lines.

The CRLF input was:

```text
RAW-CUA-FT-CRLF-A-31\r\nRAW-CUA-FT-CRLF-B-47
```

The three-line CJK/digit input was:

```json
"\u8f66\u6b21 G7391\nRAW-CUA-FT-\u4e2d\u6587-\u4e0a\u6d77\u8679\u6865-20261002\n\u6570\u5b57 12345"
```

## Results

Each variant was run once; repeatability is unknown. The foreground receipt was `global_input` / `unverifiable`; content was compared from the later snapshot.

| Input | Observed document value |
| --- | --- |
| Single-line ASCII control | Exact match |
| Single-line CJK/digit control | Exact match |
| ASCII lines separated by LF | Both lines remained; UIA represented the line break as `\r` |
| `RAW-CUA-FT-CRLF-A-31\r\nRAW-CUA-FT-CRLF-B-47` | Second line was lost; readback was `RAW-CUA-FT-CRLF-A-31\r77777777777777777777` |
| Three-line CJK/digit sample above | First line changed; the readback ended with eight `5` characters: `\u8f66\u6b21 T-\u4e2d\u6587-\u4e0a\u6d77\u8679\u6865-20261002\r55555555` |

## Control

With a fresh element token, the background `type_text` route preserved the tested multiline characters in the later snapshot, although receipts often said `unverifiable` or verification pending. This does not confirm the receipt. `set_value` also changed the control value, but it replaces the whole value and is not equivalent to typing at the current cursor or selection.
